title: Mezzo's Money
description: Withdraw, depose and transfer money & cash globally with working ATMs
body:
# Mezzos Money Mod ![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4114b27b5640ab40ebf1b586e2ddde0d1e0a6767.png) This mod adds a fully functional ATM and cash to your world. Players are able to depose or withdraw cash from their bank accounts **AND** are able to transfer money to other players since version 2.0. ***NEW: Multiplayer SUPPORT and Neoforge*** ## Features **Version 2.0 ++**
✅Multiplayer support
✅Transfer and send money to other players' bank accounts
✅Access bankaccount via GUI
✅Clean and new GUI
✅Credit card item, to quickly see how much money you have in your account
✅Cash register block for decoration
✅Serveradmins can change/set/see players' bank accounts via command
✅All from version 1.0 **Version 1.0**
✅Withdraw and depose cash to your bankaccount ## Version overview For different MC versions there are different mod versions available: | Loader | MC Version | V1 ? | V2 ? | |----------|-----------------|--------------------------------|------| | Fabric | 1.21.8 | ❌ | ✅ | | Neoforge | 1.21.1 / 1.21.8 | ❌ | ✅ | | Forge | 1.19.4 / 1.20.1 | ⚠️ Yes but: no longer supported | ✅ | | Fabric | 1.20.1 | ⚠️ V1.2 extended: Version 1 but including some V2 features | ⚠️❌ | ## Usage **Depose and withdraw cash** Get the ATM out of the creative tab "Mezzos Money"(cannot be crafted yet) and place it. Right click it. A GUI should open. You are able to see your Bank balance here and you can depose money by putting cash in the slot and hitting the "depose" button. To withdraw money just type the amount you want to withdraw in the black field and hit "withdraw". The cash should automatically be added to players inventory. **Transfer money to other players (Version 2.0 ++ only)** Get the "Transfer ATM" block out of the creative tab "Mezzos Money" and place it. Right click it. A GUI should open. Now you have 2 options: 1. Enter playername in the name field 2. Select a player by using the arrows to scroll through the online list. (Leave the player name field blank.) Players need to be online! Enter the amount of money you want to transfer and press "Transfer money". **Serveradmin commands** To use and execute these commands, you need to have the permission level 3. Find out more about permission levels [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Permission_level) /MezzosMoneyMod [Argument] Available arguments: 1. `bankaccount` with `change` `set` `get` and `PLAYERNAME` arguments 2. `ShowOnlinePlayers` just... ehm... shows online players on multiplayer servers Example: /MezzosMoneyMod bankaccount change PLAYERNAME -10 ## Information Version 1.0 In version 1, the bank balance is stored in minecraft scoreboard so it is easier for server admins to manage players money. Scoreboard: _BankAccount_ Due to the Minecraft scoreboard's refresh rate, the scoreboard must be displayed for Team white permanently. Otherwise the mod cannot display the correct bank balance. By default, it is not visible to any player unless they switch to Team white using a command. So it shouldn't bother anyone. This is fixed in version 2.0++ ## Bugs and suggetions & questions Please report any bugs or translation mistakes on my discord. :)

## Credits A big thanks to [Sarocesch](https://modrinth.com/user/Sarocesch) for allowing me to use his money textures. His linktree can be found [here](https://minewache.de/links) I am also thankfull because [Kanaavi](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/kanaavi/) allowed me to use the ATM 3D block model.
